name: code-review-graph
description: Code review and blast-radius analysis using knowledge graphs
author: Qwen Code Skills

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build or update the code review graph for the current project

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review changes since last commit with blast-radius analysis

commands.name: blast
commands.description: Analyze the blast radius (impact) of changing a file or function

commands.name: search
commands.description: Semantic search across the codebase using the knowledge graph

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show statistics about the code graph (nodes, edges, languages)

commands.name: visualize
commands.description: Generate an interactive HTML visualization of the code graph

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show help information for code-review-graph commands
